title.ko: 추가적인 이용·제공이 지속적으로 발생 시 판단 기준
title.en: Criteria for ongoing additional use or provision

rules.statement: Where use or provision without consent, within a scope reasonably related to the original purpose, occurs continuously, state: recipient, items, purpose of use/provision, recipient's retention period.

check.expr: every(section.S08.rows, r => r.recipient && r.items && r.purpose && r.retention)

rules.statement: Publish the processor's own judgment criteria for the four considerations: relation to the original purpose; predictability given collection context or practice; no undue harm to the data subject's interests; pseudonymization, encryption or other safety measures.
The body may carry the criteria while current details are kept on a separate linked page.

goodPatterns: Lead-in: additional use/provision without consent may occur under PIPA 15(3) or 17(4), considering Decree 14-2.
Table: recipient | items | purpose | recipient's retention (or a 'view current list' link).
Four short bullets, one per consideration, each tied to the concrete service (e.g. ride-hailing: related to original purpose; users expect it; needed for the requested service; safe-number masking).

commonDefects.defect: Cites 15(3)/17(4) but gives no criteria, or copies the four statutory headings without service-specific judgment.
Uses this section to cover processing that actually needs consent (e.g. marketing to affiliates).

extractionHints: AI training on service data without consent (see A1 (5))
ongoing sharing with drivers, merchants, partners

needsVerification.note: Whether a given use is 'reasonably related' is a legal judgment; C1 must mark R-S08-002 needs_manual_review when evidence is thin.
